edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the dispute between them that is the subject of this Agreement (the “Dispute”). The parties will identify the Dispute by case caption and number, if applicable, or an agreed description before execution.
edits.name: Limit scope of settlement

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] (the “Settlement Amount”) within 14 calendar days after the date on which both parties have executed this Agreement (the “Effective Date”), by wire transfer to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. Payment is complete only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds.
edits.name: Proposed payment deadline

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising from the Dispute based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the Effective Date. This release does not extend to unrelated claims or to rights or obligations under this Agreement, including the right to enforce it.
edits.name: Dispute-specific release conditioned on cleared funds

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that a party may disclose them to its professional advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations, to the extent required by law, regulation, or court order, or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. For a legally required disclosure, the disclosing party shall, to the extent legally permitted and reasonably practicable, give the other party advance notice and limit disclosure to what is required.
edits.name: Confidentiality exceptions
